from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document relevant to the task."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as stated in the text")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) specified in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentInfo] = Field(description="List containing the extracted info for the current document")
